description: Detects a hidden temp-directory process accessing cloud creds, SSH keys, browser stores, crypto wallets, and AI-tool config directories enumerated in the jscrambler stealer report
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/compromised-jscrambler-8140-npm-release.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/14
tags:
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1552.001
  - attack.t1005
logsource:
  category: file_access
detection:
  proc_from_temp:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Temp\'
      - '/tmp/'
      - '/var/folders/'
  secret_targets:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\.aws'
      - '\.ssh'
      - '\Google\Chrome\User Data'
      - '\Microsoft\Edge\User Data'
      - 'Bitwarden'
      - 'MetaMask'
      - 'Exodus'
      - 'Phantom'
      - '\Cursor'
      - '\Windsurf'
      - '\Code\User'
      - 'Claude'
      - 'Zed'
  condition: proc_from_temp and secret_targets
level: high
2790.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where ((Filesystem.file_path="*\\.aws*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.azure*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*gcloud*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.ssh*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*Bitwarden*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*MetaMask*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*Exodus*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*Phantom*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*Cursor*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*Windsurf*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*Claude*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*Zed*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Code\\User*") AND (Filesystem.process_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.process_path="*/tmp/*" OR Filesystem.process_path="*/var/folders/*")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2790.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileOpenInfo ContextImageFileName=/[\\\/](Temp|tmp|folders)[\\\/]/i
| regex("aws|[.]ssh|Chrome[\\\\/]+User Data|Edge[\\\\/]+User Data|Bitwarden|MetaMask|Exodus|Phantom|Cursor|Windsurf|Claude|Zed", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())
| count > 3

title: Nuclio CronJob Shell Command Injection Runtime Execution (CVE-2026-52831)
id: 3f2b9c7a-8d41-4e62-b5a9-7c1e4f0a9d21
status: experimental
description: Detects a shell process built from a Nuclio cron-trigger curl command that also reads the Kubernetes service-account token or contains command substitution, indicating CVE-2026-52831 exploitation.

  product: linux

  selection_curl:

      - '--header'

level: high

| search (process="*/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token*" OR process="*$(*" OR process="*; id*" OR process="*; echo*")

status: experimental
description: Detects a web-server process (php-fpm/apache/nginx) writing an executable PHP file into a Mautic Symfony config, var/cache, var/logs or media directory, consistent with the CVE-2026-9559 campaign-import path-traversal RCE.
references:
  - https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-6r9h-4h75-7q4x
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-9559
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/09
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/php-fpm'
      - '/php-fpm8.1'
      - '/php-fpm8.2'
      - '/php-fpm8.3'
      - '/httpd'
      - '/apache2'
      - '/nginx'
  selection_dir:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/config/'
      - '/var/cache/'
      - '/var/logs/'
      - '/media/'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.php'
      - '.phtml'
      - '.phar'
      - '.pht'
  filter_symfony:
    TargetFilename|contains: '/var/cache/'
    TargetFilename|endswith: 'ProjectContainer.php'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_dir and selection_ext and not filter_symfony
level: high
2984.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.action=created OR Filesystem.action=modified) (Filesystem.file_path="*/config/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/var/cache/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/var/logs/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/media/*") (Filesystem.file_name="*.php" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.phtml" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.phar" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.pht" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.php5" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.php7") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where process_name IN ("php-fpm","php-fpm8.1","php-fpm8.2","php-fpm8.3","php-fpm7.4","httpd","apache2","nginx","php") | where NOT (like(file_path,"%/var/cache/%") AND (like(file_name,"Container%") OR like(file_name,"%ProjectContainer.php") OR like(file_name,"srcApp_Kernel%Container.php"))) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2984.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| ContextImageFileName=/(php-fpm|httpd|apache2|nginx)/i
| TargetFileName=/\/(config|var\/cache|var\/logs|media)\/.*\.(php|phtml|phar|pht|php5|php7)$/i
| NOT (TargetFileName=/\/var\/cache\/.*(Container|ProjectContainer)\.php$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

id: 5b2f9a41-7c3e-4d16-9a02-1f6d8e4a7c11
description: Successful POST to /api/documents/upload or /api/documents/batch-upload with no Authorization header, indicating exploitation of the missing-auth boundary in mcp-memory-service < 10.67.1
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-84hp-mqvj-3p8h
  - https://advisories.gitlab.com/pypi/mcp-memory-service/CVE-2026-50027/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/15
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1565.001
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: POST
    sc-status: 200
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/api/documents/upload'
      - '/api/documents/batch-upload'
  filter_auth:
    cs(Authorization)|exists: true
  condition: selection and not filter_auth
level: high
2996.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.status) as status values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agent from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*/api/documents/upload*" OR Web.url="*/api/documents/batch-upload*") Web.http_method=POST Web.status=200 by Web.src Web.dest Web.uri_path Web.http_method
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where count > 0
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - count

2998.sent:
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Url has "/api/documents/search-content/" or Url has "/api/documents/history"
| where HttpMethod =~ "GET"
| where toint(HttpStatusCode) == 200
| where isempty(HttpRequestHeaderAuthorization)
| summarize ReqCount = count(), DistinctUrls = dcount(Url), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where ReqCount > 50 or DistinctUrls > 10   // >50 reads or >10 distinct doc IDs in 5m = systematic enumeration
| order by ReqCount desc
2998.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count as reqCount dc(Web.uri_path) as distinctPaths min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*/api/documents/search-content/*" OR Web.url="*/api/documents/history*") Web.http_method=GET Web.status=200 by Web.src Web.dest span=5m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where reqCount > 50 OR distinctPaths > 10
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - reqCount

2999.sent:
let window = 10m;
let probes = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where Url has "/api/memories"
    | where toint(HttpStatusCode) == 401
    | project ProbeTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr;
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Url has "/api/documents/"
| where toint(HttpStatusCode) == 200
| where HttpMethod in~ ("POST","DELETE","GET")
| where isempty(HttpRequestHeaderAuthorization)
| join kind=inner probes on SrcIpAddr
| where TimeGenerated between (ProbeTime .. ProbeTime + window)
| project ProbeTime, DocTime = TimeGenerated, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, ProbeTime), SrcIpAddr, HttpMethod, Url, HttpStatusCode
| order by DocTime desc
2999.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/api/memories*" Web.status=401 by Web.src
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rename firstTime as probeTime, count as probe401
| join type=inner src [
  | tstats summariesonly=true count as docSuccess min(_time) as docTime values(Web.uri_path) as docPaths from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/api/documents/*" Web.status=200 (Web.http_method=POST OR Web.http_method=DELETE OR Web.http_method=GET) by Web.src
  | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` ]
| where docTime >= probeTime AND docTime <= probeTime+600
| eval delaySec=docTime-probeTime
| table src probeTime docTime delaySec probe401 docSuccess docPaths
| sort - docTime
